subject: [PATCH 00/12] mm/collapse: separate a collapse from its callers

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch set separates the collapse engine from its callers, introducing a clear interface and policy between them. The collapse engine is moved to khugepaged.c, but it now has an interface that allows callers to specify their own policies and interact with the engine without reaching into each other's code. The patch also moves MADV_COLLAPSE to madvise.c, where it belongs, and introduces four new calls: collapse_control_init, collapse_policy_set, collapse_scan_pmd, and collapse_run_pmd. This separation improves modularity and maintainability of the code.
